name: Pet damage vs prime evils
description: Pets hitting a prime evil are scaled by difficultylevels.txt PlayerDamagePercentVSPrimeEvil, the same percent players get. Pet vs player keeps PetDamagePercentVSPlayer. Every other attacker/defender pairing is unchanged. D2R 3.3.0 (93847), D2RLoader 1.3.0 process image. Replaces the 2.4 PetVSPrimeEvil hook (325902) and cave (36337E); no cave is needed.

patches.description: SUNITDMG_CalculateTotalDamage (0x44DF10), inlined difficultylevels pairing classifier, pet-attacker branch (attacker has unit flag 0x80000000 and is not a hireling). Stock: defender is not a player -> jne 0x44EB25 (no scaling). Patched: jne 0x44E547, the player branch's own prime-evil test: mov rcx,rsi (defender) / call 0x3B0250 (monstats primeevil flag) / je 0x44EB25 (not a prime evil, no scaling) / mov ecx,[rbx+34h] (PlayerDamagePercentVSPrimeEvil, loader offset 0x34) / jmp 0x44E62D (shared scaling join). rsi = defender and rbx = difficulty record on both paths; nothing in 0x44E513-0x44E62D writes rbx, rsi or r13. Only the rel32 changes. Keystone-assembled at 0x44E624, capstone-verified.
